001: Did you end up signing up for the photography club?
Yes, on Tuesday I went to the first meeting and I really liked it.
And what did you do in that first session?
We were looking at other members' work and then we went out to practice around campus.
How nice! I would love to go on one of those outings.
Well, the next one is Saturday morning, if you want I'll let you know.
002: Hey, is the debate club still accepting new people?
I think so, but you have to go through a short interview with the coordinator.
An interview? I didn't know it was that serious.
It's just to get to know you and see your level, don't worry.
Okay, then I'll go ahead and sign up next week.
That sounds great to me, so we can go to the meetings together.
003: Have you ever been to any of the mountain club's activities?
I went once in the fall and honestly we had a really good time.
And what are the people who go there like?
They're really nice and they're always willing to help newcomers.
I feel like trying it, but I've never been on a trail.
No problem, there are people of all levels and they always take it easy.
004: The theater club is preparing a play for the end of the year.
Yeah, I saw it advertised around campus. Are you taking part?
I'm thinking about signing up, but I'm a bit embarrassed.
Don't overthink it, rehearsals have a really good vibe.
Do you think I could be any good without having experience?
Of course, there are roles for everyone and they help you loosen up.
005: How was the trip that the hiking club organized?
It was great, although the path was a bit muddy from the rain.
And were there many of you?
There were about fifteen of us and honestly it turned into a really nice group.
I would have liked to go, but that weekend I wasn't in town.
Well, don't miss the next one, they usually organize one a month.
006: I'm thinking about joining the volunteering club, what do you think?
I think it's a great idea, plus you meet very committed people.
And what kind of activities do they usually take part in?
Mostly they help at community kitchens and organize food drives.
That sounds really good, I think doing something like that will be good for me.
Definitely, and it also looks great on your résumé.
007: Is the language club still meeting on Thursday afternoons?
Yes, but they've changed the schedule now and they start at six.
Oh, perfect, so I can get there after class.
And which language did you want to practice there?
Mostly English, although I'm also interested in Italian.
Well, there's an Italian conversation group on Fridays, in case you're interested.
008: Did you hear that the robotics club is going to hold an open workshop?
Yes, I saw it on the university's social media and I think it looks really interesting.
Do you think you need to know a lot to take part?
No, they say it's designed for beginners and they teach you from scratch.
Then I'll sign up, that world has always caught my attention.
Well, me too, so we'll sign up together and go.
009: The film club is going to screen a Spanish movie on Friday.
Really? I would love to go, do you know what time it is?
I think it starts at seven in the auditorium.
And is admission free or do you need to get a ticket?
It's free, but they say you have to get there early because it fills up.
Well, let's get there a bit earlier and make sure we get a spot.
010: Are you still going to the chess club or did you quit?
I still go, although lately fewer people show up than I'd like.
And why do you think attendance has dropped?
I guess exams and the bad weather don't help much.
You could organize a tournament to get people excited.
Good idea, in fact we're already thinking about it for next month.
